BrochureContent.Content:
4 Leicester Avenue represents a rare opportunity to acquire a distinguished Victorian residence that successfully combines architectural character, outstanding modern accommodation and excellent energy efficiency. Beautifully renovated, exceptionally comfortable and located in one of Dublin's most desirable neighbourhoods, this is a remarkable family home of enduring quality and appeal.

A Rare Combination of Victorian Elegance and Contemporary Living
Artis is delighted to present 4 Leicester Avenue, a truly exceptional Victorian residence situated on one of Dublin 6's most sought-after residential streets. Behind its handsome period façade lies a beautifully reimagined family home that seamlessly blends historic character with the comforts, efficiency and functionality expected of modern living.
Extending to approximately 214 sq.m. (2,303 sq.ft.), the property has been comprehensively refurbished and thoughtfully extended. Great care has been taken to preserve the architectural integrity and charm of the original home while introducing outstanding contemporary accommodation designed around family life.
The result is a wonderfully spacious, light-filled home with impressive proportions throughout. The elegant reception rooms retain their period grandeur, while the magnificent kitchen, dining and family space forms the heart of the home, opening effortlessly to the sunny south-facing garden beyond.
In addition to its aesthetic appeal, the property offers excellent energy efficiency, benefiting from underfloor heating across the ground floor, enhanced insulation, solar thermal panels and a sophisticated hot water system. These features deliver exceptional comfort while reducing energy consumption, creating a home that is both environmentally responsible and economical to run.


Accommodation
A crushed granite footpath surrounding the front lawn and attractive repointed brick façade provide an elegant introduction to the property. The welcoming entrance hall immediately showcases the home's original character, featuring wide-plank pitch pine flooring, ornate period detailing and a striking staircase rising through the house.
To the front are two magnificent interconnecting reception rooms, ideal for both entertaining and everyday family living. High ceilings, decorative cornicing, original fireplaces and charming period details create a refined atmosphere, while large windows fill the spaces with natural light. French doors lead directly from the south-facing dining room to a secluded courtyard.
Beyond the reception rooms, the house transitions seamlessly into its contemporary extension. A practical utility and plant room houses the impressive solar-assisted hot water system and laundry facilities.
Designed as the social hub of the home, the impressive kitchen and family room has been thoughtfully crafted for modern family living. High-gloss white cabinetry is paired with solid wood worktops and porcelain tiled floors, creating a timeless yet contemporary aesthetic. The comfortable living area with built in speakers for a home cinema system, provides the perfect backdrop for family gatherings and movie nights. Large aluminium-clad bi-fold doors flood the room with natural light and open effortlessly onto the south-facing garden, creating a seamless flow to the outdoor kitchen and alfresco dining area, ideal for entertaining throughout the warmer months.
The first-floor return accommodates a generous fourth bedroom, currently used as a home office, together with an elegant family bathroom featuring a classic claw-foot bath.
On the main first floor, the principal bedroom suite occupies the front of the house and includes two walk-in wardrobes and a spacious ensuite bathroom. A second large double bedroom overlooks the rear garden.
The converted attic level provides another luxurious bedroom suite, accessed via a stunning modern oak and copper staircase. This impressive space includes bespoke storage, dormer windows and a stylish ensuite bathroom.


Gardens & Outdoor Living
The outdoor spaces have been carefully designed to complement the quality of the interior accommodation. A sheltered courtyard, complete with pergola and awning, provides an intimate setting for outdoor dining and relaxation. Perfect for a morning coffee.
The south-facing terrace features a glass-covered pergola and a bespoke concrete outdoor kitchen, creating an exceptional year-round entertaining space. Beyond lies a private lawned garden framed by mature planting and attractive stone boundary walls, offering a peaceful retreat in the heart of the city.
A generous block-built garden workshop is discreetly positioned at the rear of the property and is serviced with electricity. Beyond its valuable storage capacity, the building is complemented by secure gated access to a private pedestrian laneway, providing a practical solution for bicycles, refuse bins and everyday household logistics without impacting the enjoyment of the garden while also offering potential for use as a home office, studio or hobby space.

Location
Leicester Avenue is widely regarded as one of Dublin's premier residential addresses. Ideally positioned between Rathgar and Rathmines, the avenue enjoys a tranquil setting while remaining within easy reach of the city centre.
Residents benefit from an outstanding selection of cafés, restaurants, boutiques and artisan food shops in nearby Rathgar, Rathmines and Ranelagh. Some of Dublin's most respected schools are within easy reach, including The High School, St Mary's College, Alexandra College, Gonzaga College, Muckross Park and Sandford Park.
The property is also conveniently located for University College Dublin, Trinity College Dublin and the M50 motorway network. A wide range of sporting and recreational facilities are nearby, including Ashbrook Lawn Tennis Club, Stratford Lawn Tennis Club, Rathgar Tennis & Bowling Club and Leinster Cricket Club.
